data.name: Viridian Corp.
data.detailed_description:
WHAT IF FREE WILL BECAME A RESOURCE?

You don't just command the war. You step into it.

Viridian Corp. is a single-player sci-fi Action RTS and third-person shooter set on a dystopian asteroid frontier. Lead the Free Cluster through its campaign against Viridian Corporation. Capture mining zones, direct troops and resources across a connected battlefield, then activate Mindwalking to take control of a soldier and fight on the ground.

The wider battle does not pause when you enter combat. Territory can still be contested. Resource routes can still shift. Every decision you make on the front line is part of the war still unfolding above.

COMMAND FROM ABOVE

Read the battlefield as a network of connected control zones. Move your forces, capture territory, defend critical routes and decide where to concentrate pressure. Each zone changes what you can reach, what you can hold and where the next battle will be fought.

MINDWALK INTO THE FRONT LINE

When orders are not enough, use Mindwalking technology to enter a soldier and take direct third-person control. Lead an assault, break a stalemate or defend a key position with your own aim, movement and abilities—then return to command with a new view of the battlefield.

Mindwalking is not a separate battle. It is another layer of the same war.

TURN TERRITORY INTO POWER

Mining zones supply Viridian Crystal, Gas and Metal Alloy. Control enough of the network to support your tactical actions, the forces you need and keep pressure on the enemy.

Coordinate infantry, armored units and engineers. Establish defenses where they matter, protect the flow of resources and turn captured ground into momentum.

SHAPE YOUR APPROACH

Choose an ability loadout before battle, unlock abilities as the conflict develops and develop talents that support your preferred approach. Combine strategic positioning with direct combat abilities to respond to each fight on your own terms.

FIGHT FOR THE FREE CLUSTER

Viridian Corporation calls it connection. The Free Cluster calls it theft.

Play through the Free Cluster campaign as independent miners and frontier survivors resist the profit-driven corporation that began the conflict over the Viridian Belt. Story and lore connect the campaign's missions through the journey of its central protagonist and reveal a far-future society in which Earth has faded into myth.

Yet both sides rely on neural technology capable of overriding the human body across vast distances. Every use of Mindwalking turns another person's will into a battlefield resource.

KEY FEATURES

  • A single-player Free Cluster campaign with story, lore and a central protagonist

  • A hybrid of real-time strategy and third-person shooting within the same ongoing battle

  • Mindwalking that lets you leave the command view and directly control a soldier

  • Connected zone warfare built around territory, routes and mining income

  • Three strategic resources: Viridian Crystal, Gas and Metal Alloy

  • Infantry, armored units, engineers and defenses to coordinate across the battlefield

  • Talent and ability systems for shaping how you command and fight

  • A morally gray dystopian conflict about corporate expansion, resistance and the price of free will

Command the network. Enter the battle.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 4-core AMD or Intel
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3600X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 1060 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
